```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`lcNRB` separates live discovery from verified data access. The catalog marks
the small set of workbooks for which extraction rules have been audited.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(lcNRB)
lc_catalog()
lc_search("inflation")
lc_search("broad money")
```

The first retrieval downloads an official workbook into a user-level cache.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
m2 <- lc_get("money_m2")
subset(m2, date >= as.Date("2020-01-01"))
lc_metadata("money_m2")
```

Fiscal series whose dates cannot be mapped exactly retain their source period.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
cpi <- lc_get("cpi")
subset(cpi, period >= "2015/16" & indicator_id == "cpi_overall_index")
```
